provenance.summary: Estimated spectral sensitivity of the ALEXA ALEV III sensor (SUP 3.x processing; ALEXA Classic through Mini LF). An estimate, not a measurement.
provenance.method: Curves whose own optimal Academy P-2013-001-style matrices equal ARRI's published native-to-ACES AP0 matrices at 17 CCTs (2000-11000 K), under a 4-component PCA prior built from the 52 measured camera curves in rawtoaces-data (all 52, penalty 1, rawtoaces illuminants), moved by a hue push (owner decision 2026-10-25, "Move ALEXA estimate"): of the curves in that family, the one that renders the 47 orange, red and ochre training reflectances (Lab hue 25-95 degrees, chroma above 12) 1.5 degrees of CIELAB hue toward yellow at 5200 K through ARRI's matrix, with the matrix RMS (0.0092 per coefficient, 0.0067 without the push) within the maximum of the 24-variant ensemble (0.0064 to 0.0093). The 24 variants in variants.csv and the band in the ensemble CSV are without the push; the estimate without it is `estimate_alexa --no-push`.
inputs: ARRI ALEXA SUP 3.x native-to-ACES AP0 matrices, 17 CCTs, 13 Nov 2013 (aces-dev v1.3.1, ARRI-supplied, AMPAS licence, data/arri/AMPAS-LICENSE.md)
52 measured camera spectral sensitivities and 190 training reflectances (rawtoaces-data, Apache-2.0)
provenance.licence: Apache-2.0 (ours), derived from AMPAS-licensed and Apache-2.0 data; see NOTICE

validation.method: leave-one-camera-out over the 52 measured cameras (training/alexa/validate_loo.py, checked by training/alexa/check_loo.py in .github/workflows/alexa-curve.yml); the numbers are those of the estimator without the hue push, which has no held-out counterpart (the push leaves the curves that agree best with the matrices on purpose)

caveats: Expected accuracy 3-5 % RFSE for this camera, not the 2.2 % LOO median (research/alexa-ssf/README.md).

The shipped curve is the estimate plus a hue push (owner decision 2026-10-25), 2.2 % RFSE from the estimate without it: the red channel is lowered at 550-585 nm (0.49 against 0.60 of peak at 580 nm) and by 0.02 to 0.04 at 615-660 nm, the green channel raised (by 0.12 at 490 nm and 0.05 at 585 nm), so that oranges, reds and ochres render less crimson. ARRI's matrices allow it and do not ask for it; the curve lies outside the 24-variant band at 68 of 243 samples, by at most 0.019 of peak (G at 600 nm). It is a choice, not a measurement.
Beyond about 660 nm the curve is mostly the prior; treat 660-720 nm as unknown.
Represents ALEXA SUP 3.x / ALEV III processing; not the ALEXA 35 or REVEAL.
Assumes ARRI made its matrices the P-2013-001 way; a different recipe adds error not captured by the leave-one-out test.
